SessionTransferSettingsDescription: Session strings and JSON backups contain the complete authorization key. Anyone with a copy can access the account.
SessionTransferRisk: **Keep this credential secret.** A session string or exported JSON file grants access to your Telegram account without an SMS code.
SessionTransferRiskConfirm: This operation exposes or uses a complete Telegram authorization key. Only continue with a credential you trust, and never share an exported value.
SessionTransferInputPlaceholder: Paste a Pyrogram session string or Mithka JSON
SessionTransferPasteHint: Paste a session string, or choose a Mithka JSON file.
SessionTransferInvalidJson: This file is not valid session backup JSON.
SessionTransferUnsupportedFormat: This session backup format is not supported.
SessionTransferUserMismatch: The session belongs to a different user than the backup declares.
SessionTransferBotUnsupported: Bot session strings cannot be imported.
SessionTransferMigrationFailed: Authorization could not be transferred to the account's data center.
SessionTransferTimeout: Session verification timed out. No account was added.
SessionTransferNetworkError: Telegram rejected the session or the network request failed.
SessionTransferDuplicate: This account is already signed in.
SessionTransferAccountLimit: The account limit has been reached.
SessionTransferFileReady: Session backup loaded. Review the warning, then import it.
SessionTransferFileWriteFailed: The session backup could not be written.
ExactSearchIntersection: Combine sender and message type locally
ExactSearchIntersectionDescription: Experimental. Probes sender and message type searches separately, continues with the smaller result stream, and checks the other condition locally. Sparse results require manual continuation and stop at a safety limit. When disabled, sender and message type remain mutually exclusive.
ExactSearchIntersectionTimedOut: Message search timed out. Try again.
ExactSearchIntersectionPartial: Search stopped at its safety limit. The results shown are incomplete.
AlwaysShowScheduledButtonDescription: Shows the scheduled messages button even when this chat has no scheduled messages. Individual chats can override this setting from the AywGram chat menu.
ChatOverridesDescription: These options override global AywGram settings for this chat. Forum topics share the same chat override.
ViewAsJsonFailed: Could not load the raw message. Check your connection and try again.
IgnoreRemoteTextDraftsDescription: Prevents ordinary text drafts received from Telegram Cloud, including clears, from replacing this account's local compose fields. This does not stop uploads from this device. Drafts can diverge between devices; Rich Message drafts still sync normally.
BlockLocalTextDraftUploadDescription: Prevents ordinary text draft creation, edits and manual clears from being sent with messages.saveDraft. Drafts remain encrypted locally and survive restart. Sending a message can still clear the server draft; Rich Message drafts and support mode are unaffected. Requests already in flight may finish.
CloudSyncDescription: Stores a portable, explicitly filtered settings backup in the AywGram helper bot's Mini App CloudStorage. Local settings always remain authoritative until you confirm a restore.
CloudSyncNotConfigured: The AywGram cloud sync service is not configured in this build. No third-party bot will be contacted.
CloudSyncErrorAccountUnavailable: The selected sync account is not signed in.
CloudSyncErrorNetwork: The cloud backup request failed. Check your connection and try again.
CloudSyncErrorNotFound: No cloud backup was found for this account.
CloudSyncErrorAccountMismatch: The cloud backup belongs to a different Telegram account.
CloudSyncErrorConflict: The cloud backup changed on another device. Check again before choosing whether to restore it or overwrite it.
CloudSyncErrorRestore: The restore could not be completed. The rollback journal was kept.
CloudSyncErrorInvalid: The cloud backup is incomplete, damaged or uses an unsupported format.
CloudSyncAppearancePreserved: Some language or appearance resources are not available on this device, so their local values were preserved.
CloudSyncPrivacyWarning: The settings backup is stored in Telegram Mini App CloudStorage and is not end-to-end encrypted. It never includes session keys, account passwords, tokens, local paths, databases or message archives. Proxy addresses and credentials are included only if Sync Proxy Servers is enabled. Continue?
CloudSyncExistingDescription: A backup for this account already exists. Review the four category differences on this page, then use the cloud backup, keep local settings, or cancel without uploading.
CloudSyncProxiesDescription: Separately includes proxy type, address, port, username and password or MTProto secret, the selected proxy, and call, IPv6 and rotation preferences. Proxy data is stored without end-to-end encryption.
CloudSyncCategoryChangeWarning: Changing the category selection changes the backup policy and creates a new cloud revision. Values outside the selected categories remain local. Continue?
CloudSyncOverwriteWarning: The cloud backup has changed. Overwriting it will create a new revision from this device while retaining the previous complete generation for recovery.
CloudSyncRestoreWarning: The cloud backup will be fully downloaded and validated before any setting is changed. A rollback journal will be kept until the application restarts successfully.
CloudSyncRestartPrompt: The cloud settings were restored and validated locally. Restart AywGram now to finish applying them? You can also restart later from this page.
CloudSyncDeleteWarning: This stops automatic sync and deletes only the AywGram manifest and matching backup chunks. Local settings are not deleted.
CloudSyncExcluded: Never synced: authorization and session keys, account passwords, passcodes, tokens, account order, local files and paths, device identifiers, databases, message history, filter contents, recent peers, window geometry, UI scale and hardware-specific settings. Proxy servers are excluded unless separately enabled.
